newsitem.title: USA: King World signs Roseanne to host daily talk show.
newsitem.headline: King World signs Roseanne to host daily talk show.

text.p: King World Productions Inc. said on Tuesday it signed television comedian Roseanne as host of a daily, one-hour, talk show starting in the fall of 1998.

King World, distributor of such television fare as "Jeopardy!" and "The Oprah Winfrey Show," said the programme would be on daytime television five days a week and would be co-produced by King World and Roseanne's production company.
The new programme was announced on the same day that the final episode of Roseanne's Emmy and Peabody Award-winning situation comedy was being shown on ABC Television, ending its nine-year run.
Terms of the agreement between King World and Roseanne were not disclosed.

"I haven't had a show that's generated this much reaction since 'Oprah.'" said King World Chairman Roger King. "Stations are coming at us already, and we believe that this will be among the biggest debuts in syndicated television history."

Roseanne's manager and show co-executive producer Jeff Wald added, "In 34 years of working in show business, I've never had as intense a bidding war as this over a client. Virtually every studio came calling after Roseanne, but the opportunity to work with King World was irresistible and we are thrilled to begin work on the new show."
